A grillhouse in Geroskipou

Platia The Grillhouse is on the main square of Geroskipou in the Paphos district. Its sign reads πλατεία, the grillhouse. Guests write about a family run place with a long menu, food cooked to order and, for some, a wedding reception with music.

What guests say

Three of 281 Google reviews, 264 of them with five stars.

“Lovely restaurant run by a very nice and kind family. Genuine and delicious food, served in very generous portions. The deserts are also very tasty.”
